text.p: Guilford Pharmaceuticals Inc said Wednesday it will offer 3,250,000 shares of common stock to the public at $20.00 per share. Delivery, said the company, is scheduled for April 14.
The offering is being managed by Oppenheimer & Co Inc, Alex Brown & Sons Inc and Hambrecht & Quist LLC.

Guilford said it intends to use the proceeds for further clinical development of its DOPASCAN product; development of neurotrophic and neuroprotective product candidates; and expansion of its drug delivery business.
Guilford develops targeted and controlled drug delivery systems using proprietary biodegradable polymers, and diagnostic products for neurological diseases and conditions.
